## Assignment record schema {#assignment-record}
The canonical current assignment is `0401.goal/06.01.md`: plain `key: value` lines, UTF-8, LF, one key per line, no other content. Version 1 requires exactly these keys, in any order:

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| `record` | `current-assignment` |
| `schema` | `00.kernel/00.00.10.work/0410.imports/01.md#assignment-record version 1` |
| `desk` | the desk folder (`00.kernel`) |
| `book` | the book of the current work (`00.00.10.work`) |
| `workflow_space` | a number declared by that book (`0`) |
| `current_work` | the repository path of the current work item |
| `pack` | the pack or packs that item executes, as repository paths joined by ` + ` |
| `assignment_state` | one of `waiting`, `released`, `running`, `returned`, `accepted`, `stopped` |
| `waits_on` | what must happen next, or `nothing` |
| `next` | the next proposed step |
| `updated` | `YYYY-MM-DD` |

A record that misses a key, repeats one, carries an unknown key, or has an empty value is malformed, and a renderer must refuse it. `00.kernel/00.live.md` is only a view of this record. It names the record's hash and is never an input to anything.
